messages.content: You are triaging a reindex regression. Cite the corpus file for every claim.
Recall latency tripled after the nightly reindex. Where should I look first?

content.text: The nightly job rewrites every shard, so a partial rebuild leaves half the shards on the old segment format and every query pays a merge cost.

messages.content: Confirmed: the shard rebuild aborted halfway and left mixed segment formats behind. Re-running the rebuild to completion restored latency.
